high_confidence.element_name: Sign Up Link with contextual prompt
high_confidence.description: There is no 'Don't have an account?' prompt text adjacent to or near a Sign Up link within the login form area.
high_confidence.violated_criterion: The login screen displays a descriptive prompt text adjacent to the Sign Up link, such as 'Don't have an account?' to contextualise the registration path.
high_confidence.feedback: The 'Sign Up Link with contextual prompt' is missing from the design at form body. This element is required by AC-01 and was not found in 5 out of 5 validation passes. QA engineers would expect this element to be present on this screen.

high_confidence.description: The password input field does not display any show/hide eye icon toggle to allow users to reveal or conceal their entered password.
high_confidence.violated_criterion: The password input field includes a show/hide toggle icon (e.g. an eye icon) that allows the user to reveal or conceal the entered password.
high_confidence.feedback: The 'Password show/hide toggle icon' is missing from the design at form body. This element is required by AC-02 and was not found in 5 out of 5 validation passes. QA engineers would expect this element to be present on this screen.
